	Matrix() { Set(a, 0); }

	inline void Unit(int len) {
		For (i, 1, len) a[i][i] = 1;
	}

	inline void Out() {
		For (i, 1, k + 1) For (j, 1, k + 1)
			std::cout << a[i][j] << (j == jend ? '\n' : ' ');
		std::cout << '\n';
	}

};

typedef Matrix<K> Mat;

	return x <= k ? ((x + step - 1) % k + 1) : x;

	step %= k; Mat res;
	For (i, 1, k + 1) For (j, 1, k + 1)

		A[0].a[1][i] = 1;

			if (power & 1) A[len] = A[len] * Move(x, (power ^ 1) << p);
			x = Move(x, 1 << p) * x; ++ p;
		}
	}

		int cur = V[T];
		if (cur) {
			static int tmp[K];
			For (times, 0, cur - 1) {
				For (i, 1, k + 1) tmp[i] = ans[i], ans[i] = 0;
				Mat B = Move(A[T], times + step);
